summary: ansible-vault encrypt encrypts one or more existing files, optionally with a vault ID and password prompt.
questions: How do I encrypt an existing YAML file with Vault?
Can I encrypt several files at once?
How do I encrypt files with a specific vault ID?

answer_card.title: Encrypt existing files
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-vault encrypt foo.yml bar.yml baz.yml
ansible-vault encrypt --vault-id project@prompt foo.yml bar.yml baz.yml
```

The command accepts multiple files at once.
